title: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
description: An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee cut menu repricing time by 95% and built a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow.

title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
description: OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio to bring AI-powered operations to life sciences R&D, helping biopharma teams accelerate drug development and advance new treatments.

title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
description: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI run amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
description: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue" take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.

title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
description: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.

title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
description: SpaceX hit profitably in the third-quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.

title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
description: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments

title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
description: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.

title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
description: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family

title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
description: Eric Schmidt’s fortune is about to get even bigger.

title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M US downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
description: New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.

title: Ex-Nvidia-turned-VC Amulya Vishwanath: ‘Physical AI is in its LEGO era’
description: It’s the moment everyone is waiting for — the ChatGPT moment for robotics, Amulya Vishwanath explained to TechCrunch’s Equity.

title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
description: Electric Plant has built an AI-powered translator to help humans listen to what plants are saying with the subtle electricity coursing through their stems.

title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
description: The U.S. has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.

title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
description: Eka Robotics may be the first robotic arm that is actually good at picking up a wide range of objects, and it is so smooth and human-like, it is wowing the industry.
